title: Experimental and theoretical investigation of a mesoporous NiCo2O4/rGO nanosheet network as a high-performance anode for lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20321-20329

Mesoporous NiCo2O4/rGO nanosheets as an anode for lithium-ion batteries demonstrates enhanced performance compared with the pristine NiCo2O4 structure owing to the synergy between NiCo2O4 and rGO.
